# LP Taxi Heraklion

> LP Taxi Heraklion is a private taxi transfer and tour service based in Heraklion, Crete, Greece. Operated by Lampros and Popi, it offers fixed-price airport transfers, port transfers, hotel pickups, and curated private tours across the island in modern Mercedes vehicles, available 24/7.

## Key Facts

- Name: LP Taxi Heraklion
- Type: Private Taxi & Transfer Service
- Location: Heraklion, Crete, Greece (71201)
- Service Area: Entire island of Crete — Heraklion, Hersonissos, Malia, Agios Nikolaos, Elounda, Rethymno, Chania, Matala
- Airport: Heraklion International Airport (HER) "Nikos Kazantzakis"
- Fleet: Modern air-conditioned Mercedes (up to 4 passengers); minivan for larger groups
- Pricing: Fixed-price private transfers agreed in advance — no meter, no hidden fees
- Payment: Cash or credit card to driver; no advance payment required
- Availability: 24/7, 365 days a year
- Languages: English and Greek
- Phone: +30 694 355 1122
- Email: lptaxiheraklion@gmail.com
- WhatsApp/Viber: +30 694 355 1122

## Sample Prices (per vehicle, not per person)

- Airport to Heraklion city center: EUR 20-25 (5 km, 10-15 min)
- Airport to Hersonissos: EUR 40-50 (26-30 km, 25-35 min)
- Airport to Malia: EUR 50-60
- Heraklion to Rethymno: EUR 120-140 (75 km, ~1 hour)
- Heraklion to Chania: EUR 180-220 (150 km, ~2-2.5 hours)
- Heraklion to Elounda: EUR 90-110
